title: Healthier Homemade Hamburger Helper
description: A homemade, healthier version of the classic Hamburger Helper dish.
steps: Add ground beef, diced onion, and minced garlic to a pot and brown until cooked through. Drain excess fat.
Stir in paprika, oregano, salt, and black pepper until combined with the meat.
Pour in chicken broth, whole milk, and tomato sauce. Stir well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is mostly absorbed and pasta is tender.
Turn off heat and stir in shredded cheddar cheese until melted and sauce is creamy.
Serve in bowls, garnished with parsley and red pepper flakes if desired.
Optional: For baked version, mix cooked pasta with breadcrumb mixture (melted butter and breadcrumbs), place in a greased 9x9 baking dish, cover, and bake at 350°F until golden and crispy.
notes:
Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/19Suq3s9WJ/

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories Approximately 500 kcal · Fat 20g · Saturated fat 8g · Unsaturated fat 12g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 70mg · Sodium 900mg · Carbs 60g · Fiber 5g · Sugar 8g · Protein 30g

healthy: Made from scratch with fresh onion and garlic instead of a boxed mix.
not_healthy: Cheddar, whole milk, butter and beef add saturated fat.
Pasta and breadcrumbs are refined carbs.
